\section{Preliminaries}\label{sec:prelim}
Let $\omega = e^{i\pi/4}$ denote the eighth root of unity.

\begin{definition}[Weight]\label{def:weight}
For $u\in\Zw$, the \emph{weight} of $u$ is $\wt(u) := \lfloor \log_2 |u|^2 \rfloor$.
\end{definition}

\begin{equation}\label{eq:wt-bound}
\wt(u) \le 2\,\wt(v).
\end{equation}

\begin{lemma}\label{lem:bound}
For all $u$ of positive weight, \eqref{eq:wt-bound} holds.
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
Use Definition~\ref{def:weight}. It is easy to see that the bound holds.
\end{proof}

\begin{lemma}\label{lem:second}
The weight is invariant under multiplication by $\omega$.
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
Immediate from the definition of weight.
\end{proof}
